mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 8.0% signals strengthening labor market conditions, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE falls below 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real GDP (GDPC1 > 13000) and housing starts (HOUST > 600) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, increasing corporate profit expectations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 > 13000 and HOUST > 600.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 100 (INDPRO > 100) signals manufacturing sector expansion, increasing output and corporate margins, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 400,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 400000) indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 400,000.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals central bank commitment to stimulus during economic weakness, supporting equity market gains over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-shock recovery regime (FEDFUNDS=0.14% and UNRATE=8.1%), continued monetary stimulus supports equity market expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during the post-shock recovery regime.
